text: [Music]
Glad I caught you before you left for
Scotland.
Just barely.
And who is your traveling companion?
A new student. Oh, new. Yes, sir. I'm
starting school as a fifth year.
How extraordinary it is indeed. None of
the faculty has ever heard of anyone
being admitted to Hogwarts so late. Nor
have I. Of course, as the other fifth
years will have been honing their
magical skills for four years now, the
headmaster asked if I could get our new
student up to speed a bit before the
term begins. Well, you couldn't have
asked for a better mentor. Professor Fig
is not only an exceptional teacher, he's
also a remarkably intuitive and gifted
wizard. A Mr. Osri is prone to flattery.
